claims.statement: In the declared two-hand/two-tip signature, every side-complement pair with one unique anatomical anchor and exactly one tip gripped by that anchor is non-isomorphic; in the restricted perfect-matching/opposite-side family, all anchor-free pairs are isomorphic and all uniquely anchored pairs are non-isomorphic.
claims.domain: The finite typed families enumerated in check_grounded_anchor.py.
claims.proof_or_source: Exhaustive enumeration in check_grounded_anchor.py and EXACT_RESULTS.json; standard finite relational-structure reasoning.
claims.thought_experiment_role: The abacus and copy/switch cases separate installed anchors from labels.

claims.statement: With a unique actual hand anchor and its unique actual grip relation, the parameter-free anchored distal-side coordinate D_side flips under the declared side-complement intervention.
claims.domain: Restricted anchored two-stick structures and any actual K-instance satisfying the same typed premises.
claims.proof_or_source: Definition of AnchoredTip and D_side; exact eight-world check; R157 only for the later UCT interpretation.
counterexamples_or_limits: external side only an analyst label
claims.thought_experiment_role: Formation and human-implemented cases test whether the route is physically installed.

claims.statement: The crossed-stick protocol supplies an actual candidate relation linking fixed anatomical hand/mechanoreceptor locations, actually held tools and exchanged distal external locations, with changed tactile temporal-order judgments and distal referral evidence.
claims.domain: Yamamoto and Kitazawa 2001 human crossed-tool protocol, not complete biological K.
claims.proof_or_source: Yamamoto and Kitazawa, Nature Neuroscience 2001, DOI 10.1038/nn721.
claims.thought_experiment_role: Provides the real comparator that abstract examples lacked.

claims.statement: If the anchor–grip–distal relations belong to one complete actual K-instance, then under C1 and R157 the grounded distal coordinate is part of experiential organization without an additional exclusive owner.
claims.domain: UCT tokens satisfying the complete-K and same-binding premises.
claims.proof_or_source: UCT I v1.2, R157 and A5F-C2.

claims.statement: The cited crossed-tool evidence does not independently identify H_tip, H_pc, ownership or agency; temporal-order/location reports cannot by themselves discharge a phenomenology bridge selected from those reports.
claims.proof_or_source: Source-scope audit plus the Kalckert–Ehrsson ownership/agency dissociation.
counterexamples_or_limits: a future independent target measure could alter this status
claims.thought_experiment_role: Copying the report while changing the route exposes nonidentity.
